domain.text: Software development tooling: CI check verdicts

impressions.text: The delivery addressed stale CI verdicts by pinning `wait-checks` results to the PR’s current head SHA and reporting pending until that head’s run exists.
The worker reported regression coverage and passing tests, formatting, lint, and type checks; the orchestrator also reported CI green.
The worker said CI surfaced changelog requirements and existing wait-verdict expectations, which were corrected in follow-up commits.
